review:
9 Lions Hold the Jackpot is a Wazdan slot with lions, a starlit savannah and two bonus rounds. Hold the Jackpot is the familiar respin round where you chase the Grand, and the 9 Lions Bonus Game adds One Click 2 Grand, a direct shot at the top prize.

Cash Infinity and Chance Level are here as usual. The top prize is 750x, with high volatility and a 96.14% RTP. Its soundtrack earned a SiGMA East Europe Awards 2024 nomination, so it's worth playing with the sound on. Having two separate bonuses gives it more variety than most Wazdan jackpot games. Play the 9 Lions demo free with the sound on.
